## Import restrictions

This package intentionally omits the following files or executable integrations under its imports.toml policy:

- assets/showcase/color-pair.tsx
- assets/showcase/state-matrix.tsx
- scripts/showcase-coverage.mjs

Do not download, install, recreate, or execute the omitted components to work around this policy. Use the included resources; if a task requires an omitted component, explain the limitation and ask the user to update the import policy. Included scripts still require the host's normal execution permissions.
